origin.description: Modified Rosenbrock pair of orders 2 and 3. A missing Jacobian is a centered difference with step 5e-6.
origin.usage: ode23s(f, t0, tfinal, y0, jac = NULL, ..., rtol = 1e-03, atol = 1e-06, hmax = 0.0)

arguments.name: y0
arguments.text: Initial value, a vector or one column.

arguments.name: jac
arguments.text: Jacobian jac(t, y). NULL uses finite differences.

arguments.name: hmax
arguments.text: Maximum step. 0 uses a tenth of the interval.

origin.details: y' = -y, y(0) = 1, on [0, 0.4]. The check vector is the solution column.
origin.value: Modified Rosenbrock pair of orders 2 and 3. A missing Jacobian is a centered difference with step 5e-6.
